narrative: 当建筑本身配合的时候，命运就会拥有一个消失点。朝它走去，整个世界便收拢成一个漏斗。
站在正中央，整个世界便向你呈现自己。一次偏离轴线的小小一步，会因为这套结构过于精准而变成一桩丑闻。
在一个没有平行退缩边缘的房间里，或者当这场戏应当显得是被“发现的”而非“设计出的”时，这就不是对的工具。除非树木本身是被种植成一条中殿的样子，否则把一条隧道强加在一片森林上就是一种谎言。
仅仅让一张脸居中是不够的。如果墙壁并没有汇聚到一个点，你得到的只是一个盒子里的正中取景而已。
how: 把镜头轴线与建筑的中线对齐。保持竖直线条不倾斜（使用位移镜头、水平仪，或后退使用更长的焦段）。
把消失点安置在一张脸上、一扇门上，或空旷的无限远处。中等广角（24mm到35mm）能展现这种漏斗效果。
过于广角会让墙壁产生弓形畸变。提示词：One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity.
when: 用它拍摄酒店、宇宙飞船、教堂中殿、地堡，以及任何应当感觉像是被设计出来的命运。不要把一条凌乱的街道摆正，就因为一张脸位于中间，而称之为单点透视。
vs: 引导线（Leading Lines）可以在没有完整轴线构造的情况下汇聚。中心构图（Centered Composition）把主体固定在轴线上，但可能只是一座没有隧道的平面祭坛。
消失点（Vanishing Point）是汇聚点本身，在两点透视中也可以偏离轴线存在。对称构图（Symmetry）经常与单点透视同时出现，但一条隧道也可以用一个不对称的物体来打破这种平衡。
建筑纹理（Architexture）可能把立面处理成一种平面质感，而不是让它指向某处。
examples_film: 《闪灵》（The Shining）把瞭望酒店的走廊指向一个感觉像是命运的点；《2001太空漫游》（2001: A Space Odyssey）用轴线对称的室内空间表现被设计出的未来。
《这个杀手不太冷》（Leon）和《布达佩斯大饭店》（The Grand Budapest Hotel）同样把大厅和门厅摆正，让秩序感成为你呼吸的空气。这是关于结构的语法，而不是一块可以照搬的地毯。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是在大厅一角拍摄、却把人物摆成居中肖像。破绽是出现两个消失点，墙壁只在一侧发生退缩。
修正方法：移动到轴线上，直到左右两侧共同汇聚，或者干脆理直气壮地把它当成一条两点透视的街道来处理。

faq.q: 电影中的单点透视（One-Point Perspective）是什么？
faq.a: 摄影机正对着一个平面。平行的退缩线汇聚于一个消失点，通常位于中轴线上。大厅、中殿和经过设计的室内空间因此变成了隧道或仪式性的空间。

faq.q: 单点透视（One-Point Perspective）与中心构图（Centered Composition）有何区别？
faq.a: 中心构图把主体放在轴线上。单点透视则把空间构建成朝向单一消失点的形态。你可以在一堵平坦的墙前把一张脸居中，却没有任何隧道；你也可以拍摄一条单点透视的大厅，而让演员站在一侧，作为一种打破平衡的手法。

faq.q: 什么时候该用单点透视（One-Point Perspective）？
faq.a: 当建筑能够形成漏斗效果时使用它：酒店、飞船、教堂、地堡，一种感觉像是被设计出来的命运。不要在不规则的空间里伪造这种效果，也不要把一颗居中的头误认为是一套消失点结构。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写单点透视（One-Point Perspective）的提示词？
faq.a: 要求一个位于轴线上的消失点和一个正对的摄影机。示例：One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity。指明这条走廊。加上“竖直线条保持垂直”。

narrative: Destiny has a vanishing point when the architecture agrees. Walk toward it and the world funnels.
Stand in the middle and the world presents. A small step off axis becomes a scandal because the construction was so true.

It is the wrong tool in a room with no parallel receding edges, or when the scene should feel found rather than designed. Forcing a tunnel onto a forest is a lie unless the trees were planted as a nave.
Centering a face is not enough. If the walls do not recede to one point, you have central framing in a box.
how: Align the lens with the centerline of the architecture. Keep verticals vertical (shift, a level, or a longer lens farther back).
Place the vanishing point on a face, on a door, or on empty infinity. A moderate wide (24mm to 35mm) shows the funnel.
Too wide bows the walls. Prompt: One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity.
when: Use it for hotels, spaceships, naves, bunkers, and any fate that should feel designed. Do not square up a messy street and call it one-point because a face is in the middle.
vs: Leading Lines may converge without a full axial construction. Centered Composition plants the subject on the axis but may be a flat altar with no tunnel.
Vanishing Point is the meeting place itself and can sit off-axis in two-point perspective. Symmetry often arrives with one-point, but a tunnel can hide an unmatched object as the break.
Architexture may flatten facade as texture instead of aiming it.
examples_film: The Shining aims Overlook corridors at a point that feels like destiny. 2001: A Space Odyssey uses axial interiors as designed future.
Leon and The Grand Budapest Hotel also square halls and lobbies so order is the air you breathe. Grammar of construction, not a carpet to copy.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a centered portrait in a hall shot from a corner. The tell is two vanishing points, a wall receding on one side only.
The fix is to move onto the axis until left and right converge together, or to own Vanishing Point as a two-point street.

faq.q: What is one-point perspective in film?
faq.a: The camera is square to a plane. Parallel receding lines meet at one vanishing point, often on the central axis. Halls, naves, and designed interiors become tunnels or ceremonies.

Centered composition puts the subject on the axis. One-point perspective constructs space toward a single vanishing point. You can center a face against a flat wall with no tunnel. You can also shoot a one-point hall with the actor off to the side as a break.

faq.q: When should I use one-point perspective?
faq.a: Use it when architecture can funnel: hotels, ships, churches, bunkers, a fate that feels designed. Do not fake it in irregular space, and do not confuse a centered head with a vanishing construction.

faq.q: How do I prompt one-point perspective for AI image or video?
faq.a: Ask for one vanishing point on axis and a square camera. Example: One-point perspective corridor toward [Subject] or through them, vanishing point on axis, Kubrick infinity. Name the corridor. Add verticals true.
